integrity: Proof is self-contained; source-specific comparisons and finite-field direct tests are separately documented; small finite experiments do not prove the general formula.
limitations: Higher-rank Rota–Baxter operators and conjugacy orbit classification are not treated.
Finite-field enumeration counts labeled maps, not isomorphism classes.
General historical priority and independent mathematical validation have not been established.
scientific_scope: Nonzero rank-one weight-zero Rota–Baxter operators on full matrix algebras over arbitrary fields, and exact labeled finite-field enumeration in all dimensions.
title: Rank-one Rota–Baxter operators on full matrix algebras: two matrix types and an exact finite-field census
